hook: A massive movement is healing the planet, and it spans 149 countries.

sections.voiceover: A massive movement is healing the planet, and it spans 149 countries.
sections.visual_cue: Satellite view of the Earth transitioning to a map highlighting global diversity.
b_roll: Satellite imagery of Earth from space

sections.voiceover: The United Nations Environment Programme released a report in Yerevan on October 29, 2026. This document details how 252 million hectares are currently under restoration. Where is all this work happening?
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing the UN report document cover with the city name Yerevan displayed.
b_roll: Aerial footage of diverse landscapes being restored

sections.voiceover: Except the vast majority of this restoration involves land-based projects.
sections.visual_cue: Split screen comparing land versus water restoration efforts.

sections.voiceover: The Straits Times noted that 232 million hectares of that total are land. These combined efforts have successfully created more than one million green jobs worldwide. Nature is making a comeback.
sections.visual_cue: Animated bar chart showing 232 million hectares of land restoration.
b_roll: Workers planting trees in a nursery
Close up of hands holding soil

sections.voiceover: That brings the total area under restoration to 252 million hectares.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing the final total of 252 million hectares.
